key_semantics.declared_instance_hash: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the EXPANDED normalized capability fact set -- the SAME support::computeDeclaredInstanceHash the [D-4](1) exec/schedule attribution sinks compute (one helper, one hash). march/vlen/vreg are SUBSUMED by this hash. Portable across symbol renames; profile-vs-explicit-list declarations hash equal. Seed rows migrated from tiling-measurements carry the @rvv fixture hash (3cd23a4e...).
key_semantics.kernel: the decode_model (measurement-row identity, e.g. 'q4_K'). The SELECTION keys on the bottleneck SHAPE (fold_model), NEVER this format name; kernel is measurement-row identity only, not a dispatch key.
key_semantics.variant: a bounded enum member (NG-1) within its variant_axis. Members are compile-time hardcoded and closed per axis; see variant_axis.

$meta.decision_rule: The memoized winner of a (declared_instance_hash, kernel, variant_axis) group = the candidate with byte_exact_gate==pass AND selection_valid_input==true AND still-feasible, with the best cold_median; on a tie / no decisive difference the SIMPLER variant wins (plain / no-tiling / lower-LMUL). A marginal non-cliff shave does NOT flip the winner (inherits tiling-measurements decision_rule: q3_K tiled +8% non-cliff => memoized winner stays plain, 'measurement itself says do not tile here'). Structural gates (e.g. SP4 register_cliff_reached) live in axis_extras, not the common value.

iron_lines_NG1_L4_I4.no_search: variant set = bounded compile-time enum; refinement = offline-profile measurement (batch), NOT online learning / autotune search / curve-fit cost model.
iron_lines_NG1_L4_I4.no_learned_cost_model: the library holds NO learnable parameters; static cost formula is only a Stage-1 pruner + no-record fallback, NEVER the cold-start ranking authority (that is [SEL-1] capability prior).
iron_lines_NG1_L4_I4.no_external_tuner_benchmark_L4: oracle is always SELF (per-cell own-variant enumeration micro-best); never cross-cell/cross-board extrapolation, never benchmarked against TVM/AutoTVM/Triton-autotune. external_tuner_hook is DOCUMENTED ONLY (default empty, not implemented).
iron_lines_NG1_L4_I4.selector_core_front_door: landing this layer requires selector-core changes to pass [SEL-2] hard-timing falsifier + T4b ablation discriminative mutation tests + full byte-exact regression + [PERF-1] eight-gate. THIS DRAFT changes no core.
iron_lines_NG1_L4_I4.measurement_is_cache_fact_I4: authority order hardware measurement > this cache > static prior; the library NEVER chooses route/compute/dtype and is NEVER a lib/ correctness or cost authority.
iron_lines_NG1_L4_I4.compiler_symmetry_required_for_selection: a vs_shipped_opp (cross-compiler) cold_median has selection_valid_input=false (成色/disclosure note only); only ab_paired / vs_generic (same-compiler) cold_median may feed memoized argmin ([CASE-COMPILER-ASYMMETRY]).

$meta.fail_closed_revalidate: The selector discards a cached winner no longer feasible under current capability facts (Stage-1 legality re-check) and falls back to the [SEL-1] prior. A stale cache never forces an infeasible variant.
$meta.byte_exact_gate: A row is written ONLY past the byte-exact gate (fail-closed): the variant product is bit-identical to the _generic construction oracle (ZERO-MODEL recompute; cert three-requirements: corpus-complete / same input path / independent oracle). Enforced at BOTH ingest (existing-cold transcription) and writeback (new offline profile).

variant_axis_registry.note: closed set of bounded selection axes this superschema unifies; each row's variant_axis names which axis its variant belongs to; axis_extras carries axis-specific structural gates.

codegen_lmul.note: DEGENERATE double-board: {mf2} single legal (m1=RVV0.7 cross-ISA non-same-board). Memory column == prior column, regret 0. NO memoized novelty (single candidate). Recorded for completeness; see design §1.

value_shape.variant_axis: which selection axis this variant belongs to (see variant_axis_registry).
value_shape.selected: true on the (declared_instance_hash, kernel, variant_axis)-group argmin the in-memory view returns; false on runner-up.
value_shape.cold_median: cold-measurement median (N>=10, T-N noise floor). Semantics = phase/board/format-bound ratio or ns; denominator per ratio_semantics.
value_shape.cold_iqr: cold-measurement IQR (dispersion / stability guard; oversized IQR => memory untrustworthy => fall to prior). Sentinel when existing source lacks a distribution.
value_shape.ratio_semantics: denominator + opponent identity of cold_median: 'vs_generic' (vs _generic reference, selection-valid) | 'vs_shipped_opp' (vs board-shipped opponent, [CASE-COMPILER-ASYMMETRY] system-account, NOT selection input) | 'ab_paired' (same-compiler A/B, selection-valid) | 'ns' (absolute ns).
value_shape.opponent_symbol: opponent kernel symbol (e.g. ggml_vec_dot_q4_0_q8_0) + caliber class (hand-brick / block-dot / parity-control / self).

snapshot.vreg_count: architectural vector register count (32 for rvv1.0).
snapshot.march: the -march the measurement was taken under.

value_shape.byte_exact_gate: 'pass' -- row written only past the gate (fail-closed; un-gated timing never cached).
value_shape.selection_valid_input: bool -- true iff cold_median is compiler-symmetric and usable as a selection input (ab_paired/vs_generic same-compiler => true; vs_shipped_opp cross-compiler => false, disclosure-only). Derived from ratio_semantics + snapshot.toolchain; materialized explicit per-row to prevent a query silently missing a guard field.
value_shape.axis_extras: object of axis-specific structural gates keyed per variant_axis_registry (e.g. sp4_tiling.register_cliff_reached, loop_order.weight_panel_larger_stream).
value_shape.source: existing provenance (T8 row / T3 row / onw2 raw / originating commit).
value_shape.ts: ISO-8601 UTC; sentinel '0' for transcribed seed rows.

ingest_sources.note: existing cold data mapped into rows[] by READ-ONLY transcription -- NO new timing (vacation iron line: no e2e / no new measurement).

external_tuner_hook.note: an optional offline-profile ingest point for an external tuner's output, PROVIDED it passes the same byte-exact gate and is transcribed as ab_paired/vs_generic rows. This is a documented插点 per [SEL-3] canon ('留外部 tuner 插点，文档化即可'); it does NOT benchmark against or import an external tuner's cost model ([L-4] no-external-tuner-benchmark). No live consumer.

acceptance_T4b.note: post-[SEL-3] fills the T4b '仅记忆'/'先验+记忆' columns (currently N/A(gated)) with HONEST numbers. See design §5.
acceptance_T4b.L1_codegen: memory column == prior column, regret 0, escape 100% -- trivial NULL ({mf2} single candidate, no memoized novelty).
acceptance_T4b.L2_tile_form: memoized argmin top-1 on cliff-reached / weight-panel-larger cells -- the ONLY axis where memory columns differ non-trivially.
acceptance_T4b.L3_paradigm: memory does NOT claim L3 (shape dispatch = structural keying, not measured argmin); == prior column ([SEL-2] already landed at prior layer).
acceptance_T4b.co_bid_regret_zero: co-bidding special row: memory column verdict == prior column verdict (memory must not de-optimize the [SEL-2] structural fix); a stale/cross-compiler false vector-win row is caught by fail-closed-revalidate + selection_valid_input=false => falls to prior => regret 0. Mutation test: inject a selection_valid_input=false fake vector-win row, assert selector still emits matrix.
acceptance_T4b.honesty: the non-trivial real numbers appear ONLY in L2. L1 is trivial (==prior), L3 is not claimed. Do NOT dress L1-trivial / L3-prior as memoized novelty.
